text_en: That certainly had his late Majesty, of sacred Memory, but seen and known what a vast and charming World he had been Master of in that Continent, he would never have parted so easily with it to the Dutch. … It affords all Things, both for Beauty and Use; 'tis there eternal Spring, always the very Months of April, May, and June; the Shades are perpetual, the Trees bearing at once all Degrees of Leaves, and Fruit, from blooming Buds to ripe Autumn
text_zh: 已故的先王陛下要是曾亲眼见过、真正了解过他在那片大陆上拥有的是怎样一个辽阔而迷人的世界，他就决不会那么轻易地把它让给荷兰人……那里样样都有，既美又有用；那里是永远的春天，总是四月、五月和六月；树荫终年不断，树上同时挂着各个时节的叶子和果实，从含苞的花蕾到成熟的秋实

text_en: he endur'd a tedious Voyage, and at last arriv'd at the Mouth of the River of Surinam, a Colony belonging to the King of England, and where they were to deliver some Part of their Slaves.
highlight_en: the Mouth of the River of Surinam
text_zh: 他熬过了漫长的航程，终于到了苏里南河口；那是英国国王的殖民地，他们要在那里交出一部分奴隶。

location: Chapter 19, What happened to them at Surinam
location_zh: 第 19 章《他们在苏里南的遭遇》
text_orig: Quand nous travaillons aux sucreries, et que la meule nous attrape le doigt, on nous coupe la main: quand nous voulons nous enfuir, on nous coupe la jambe: je me suis trouvé dans les deux cas. C’est à ce prix que vous mangez du sucre en Europe.
highlight_orig: C’est à ce prix que vous mangez du sucre en Europe
text_en: When we work at the sugar-canes, and the mill snatches hold of a finger, they cut off the hand; and when we attempt to run away, they cut off the leg; both cases have happened to me. This is the price at which you eat sugar in Europe.
highlight_en: the price at which you eat sugar in Europe
text_zh: 我们在糖厂干活，石磨轧住了手指，他们就砍掉我们的手；我们想逃跑，他们就砍掉我们的腿：这两样我都碰上了。你们在欧洲吃的糖，就是这个代价。
highlight_zh: 你们在欧洲吃的糖，就是这个代价
